listing.name: F-Zero GX — fzerogx-recomp (ethannicholas) (ethannicholas)
listing.summary: Upstream claims complete desktop and VR support with no known issues. Portcove has not confirmed those claims. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA GFZE01 disc in ISO or CISO form. Its main.dol must have SHA-1 421c88106697d3275a3fc26fb7a01bf6d816b271. Convert RVZ or GCZ files first using upstream instructions.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build from source and generate code locally. The first build briefly runs the game to capture a module assembled at runtime; review that step before starting it. Keep your disc image available while playing.

warnings: Upstream claims complete desktop and VR support with no known issues. Portcove has not confirmed those claims.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
